- $450k committed: commercial PO being processed (Procurement looped below).

2) Ben — any engineering / canary deploy risks we should call out in the QBR slide?
3) Laura — please stitch a 1-slide summary (90 words) of the commercial ask and the recommended QBR ask (discount/credit ask or exec intro).
